name: Pipeline Merger for Distributed Rendering
definition: A module that combines partial rendering results from local sub-processors and adjacent pipeline stages, handling both obscuration (for view/layer/z-shade) and accumulation (for integrate/histogram) modes.
summary: The Pipeline Merger is a distributed compositing module that combines partial rendering results by synchronizing two input channels to determine obscuration priority based on slice order, rather than using a global sort-last approach.
